text: Android: Robolectric repo/view-model tests flake with UncaughtExceptionsBeforeTest from a Room invalidation refresh crossing test boundaries

Third sighting, 2026-09-19: ListPropsViewModelTest > "confirmLeave calls the server and hard-deletes the list and its items locally" — UncaughtExceptionsBeforeTest thrown inside setUp() (an exception from the previous test leaked into this runTest), then tearDown() cascades with "lateinit property server has not been initialized" at ListPropsViewModelTest.kt:97 because setUp never got that far. Same root cause; a class that reaches tearDown before setUp finished should also guard its lateinit closes.

Reproduction rate measured 2026-09-19 by running ListPropsViewModelTest alone, six times alternating between an untouched HEAD worktree and a tree with the T-212 change: HEAD failed 1 of 3, T-212 failed 1 of 3, always "confirmLeave ..." right after "duplicateList ...". So the class fails roughly one run in three on its own and is independent of any recent change; the trigger is the previous test's Room DB left open while its invalidation-tracker refresh thread is still running.
